card.name: Digits and units inside numeric ranges
card.fires_on: A digit, or the unit right after a number, in the second half of a numeric range or quantity such as '55% to 369%' or '1 to 2 weeks'. It is strongest on a digit partway through a multi-digit number.

modes.label: Digit inside a range
modes.description: A digit within the upper end of a number range, often a percent or dose.

modes.label: Unit after a range
modes.description: A unit word or percent sign right after a number that ends a range or comparison.
